description: Cost Control Analyst Catalonia Hotels & Resorts Hanover / St. James / Trelawny Not disclosed Temporary full-time Updated 28/10/2026 HRM Apply Now Share Share this job Facebook Twitter Report This Job Save Save We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Cost Control Analyst to join our team and contribute to the continued success of our organization. Catalonia Hotels & Resorts is an international hotel chain recognized for its commitment to excellence, quality service, and exceptional guest experiences. With a growing portfolio of hotels and resorts in prime destinations, we are dedicated to innovation, operational excellence, and the professional development of our team members. We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Cost Control Analyst to join our team and contribute to the continued success of our organization. Overview The Cost Control Analyst is responsible for monitoring, analyzing, and controlling costs across all hotel departments, with a strong focus on Food & Beverage, Purchasing, Inventory Management, and Operating Expenses. The role ensures that established cost control procedures are followed, identifies opportunities for cost savings, and supports management in maximizing profitability while maintaining high service standards. Responsibilities Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly food, beverage, and operational costs. Monitor warehouse reservations (SAP) and ensure that all transactions are properly recorded in the system on the day the items are received and dispatched. Conduct regular inventory counts and reconcile stock variances. Analyze inventory usage, wastage, spoilage, and losses, providing recommendations for corrective action. Review purchase orders, invoices, goods received notes, and supplier pricing to ensure accuracy and compliance. Verify that all goods and services are purchased according to approved procurement procedures. Prepare monthly cost control reports, variance analyses, and management summaries. Monitor departmental spending against budgets and identify cost-saving opportunities. Perform spot checks of storerooms, bars, kitchens, restaurants, and operational areas to ensure proper inventory controls are maintained. Ensure all inventory movements are accurately recorded in the hotel management and inventory systems. Investigate discrepancies related to inventory, purchasing, receiving, and consumption. Assist with month-end closing processes, inventory valuation, and financial audits. Maintain and update standard costing models and inventory records. Support the Finance Department in forecasting, budgeting, and financial planning activities. Ensure compliance with company policies, internal controls, and audit requirements. Collaborate with department heads to improve operational efficiency and reduce unnecessary expenditure. Follow-up on receipt of construction containers. Review and Report Possible ASSETS Label all warehouse receipts and maintain inventory control for the construction warehouse stock Education & Experience Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or a related field. Minimum of 3 years' experience in cost control, accounting, inventory management, or a similar role within the hospitality industry. Experience working in a hotel, resort, or all-inclusive property is strongly preferred. Experience working on projects or renovations of buildings. Strong understanding of food and beverage cost control principles. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and financial analysis. Experience with hotel management systems, inventory software, and ERP SAP platforms At Catalonia Hotels & Resorts, we believe that diversity strengthens our organization.
